sources.title: GR00T Dreams - GitHub
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T-Dreams blueprint generates vast amounts of synthetic trajectory data using NVIDIA Cosmos world foundation models, prompted by a single image and language instructions. This enables robots to learn new tasks in unfamiliar environments without needing specific teleoperation data.
